description: System orchestrator responsible for lifecycle management, module coordination, dependency wiring, and event/hook propagation.

business_logic_definition.note: Kernel contains orchestration logic only, never business logic.

rules: Kernel is the single owner of lifecycle state
Illegal transitions MUST throw BaseError-derived errors
Modules MAY register services, hooks, and events
Kernel MUST NOT depend on module internals
Kernel MAY emit lifecycle and coordination events
Events MUST NOT alter control flow
Kernel MUST function without any listeners
Hooks are part of explicit lifecycle phases
All runtime errors MUST extend BaseError
Kernel MUST NOT define domain-specific error codes
Kernel APIs are stable orchestration contracts
Internal helpers MUST NOT be exported

review_exceptions.exception: Lifecycle orchestration logic is explicitly allowed
Kernel MAY throw BaseError-derived errors for lifecycle violations
